title: One-Way requests fail with generic error under load
description: Wonka Labs: One-Way UI shows ERR_UPSTREAM on questions that take a long time. Chat UI users report 'timed out'. Started this week, customer IP range 203.0.113.0/24.
resolution_notes: Gateway logs showed provider latency around 9.5s and success, but the UI hop gives up at 8s (platform.http.timeout_ms). Raised platform timeout for the tenant with platform on-call. LLM gateway was healthy.
